records.name: Soaring Fist
records.dlc_requirement: Extra Pack 2 / later free-update TP Medal Shop availability
records.skill_description: A ranged Strike Super that punches the air to create an energy burst; holding the input can launch up to three bursts and increases their distance.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a pseudo-Ki-Blast Strike Super with short-to-mid range, one to three hits, chargeable input, and knockback. A single input creates one projectile; holding the button can produce three and increases their range.
records.acquisition_notes: Soaring Fist originated as Goku (Ultra Instinct)'s Extra Pack 2 Super Skill. A later free update made it purchasable by the Future Warrior in the TP Medal Shop, and Jiren can equip it through Partner Customization.
records.pve_notes: TP Medal Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Chargeable pseudo-Ki-Blast Strike Super with up to three projectiles and increasing distance; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
